Bug_Title: "equals" methods should be symmetric and work for subclasses
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the equals method of the Fruit class where it uses 'Fruit.class == obj.getClass()' to check equality. This breaks the symmetry requirement of the equals contract because a Raspberry (a subclass of Fruit) will not be considered equal to a Fruit when the Fruit's equals method is called, but a Fruit will be considered equal to a Raspberry when the Raspberry's equals method is called.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling demo.showBug(), which demonstrates the asymmetry in the equals method between Raspberry and Fruit objects.
